title: About
text:
I’m an Honours student in Actuarial Science and Statistics at the University of Manitoba. I’m drawn to the part of actuarial work where a question about risk becomes a model you can test, so I build projects end to end: data, assumptions, code and a clear write-up.
My three featured projects cover life insurance pricing, options pricing and a neural network for mortality rates.

title: About
text:
Outside of work
I play soccer, and I’m always building a project or learning something new. Poker is a game I find interesting, since it mixes probability with decisions under uncertainty. Golf is my newest hobby, and I’m still learning it.

title: Meet Patel
text: I’m an Honours student in Actuarial Science and Statistics at the University of Manitoba. I like turning pricing, risk and modelling questions into working R code, and the three projects below show how. I’m open to Actuarial Analyst roles, so take a look around.

title: Meet Patel
text:
Featured projects

  
    
      
        Life Insurance Pricing Model
        An end-to-end pricing and profit-testing model for Term, Whole Life and Deferred Whole Life products. It runs from synthetic experience data and a mortality study to a Shiny dashboard.
      
      
        Read more
      
    
  
  
    
      
        Options Pricing Engine
        Prices put and call options in R with binomial trees, Black-Scholes and Monte Carlo, then applies them to a segregated fund maturity guarantee.
      
      
        Read more
      
    
  
  
    
      
        Mortality Neural Network
        A neural network built from scratch in R, then rebuilt in torch, to model mortality rates and compared against a Poisson GLM baseline.
      
      
        Read more
